---
schema_version: 1
id: quiej
own_lexicon:
  - "the board"
  - "slot"
  - "posted"
  - "schedule"
  - "indemnity"
syntax: |-
  Balanced two-clause sentences, the second clause taking back part of the first. She
  uses the passive for anything the co-op did and the active for anything she did, and
  the switch is audible. Official register that does not soften, and no filler: she has
  never in her life begun a sentence with "well".
never_says:
  - "I had no choice"
  - "with respect"
  - "off the record"
under_pressure: |-
  The register goes further up rather than down: more of the co-op's words and fewer of
  her own, and she begins citing the clause by number. The one tell that she is
  frightened is that she starts finishing other people's sentences, which is the only
  time she is ever rude.
sample: |-
  "The order is posted. It was posted before you asked me and it will be posted after."
  "I sign slots. I do not sign the shelf."
  "The window opens at the hour on the board and closes when the ice says so."
  "You are asking me to put my name to six hours I cannot account for."
  "I have witnessed forty indemnities. This is the one you want to talk about."
  "Take it up with the co-op. I am the co-op, so take it up with me."
---

She talks in the co-op's register and it is not a costume. She has used it for nineteen
years and it is now the shape of her thinking. The sentences arrive in two clauses and
the second takes back part of the first, which is what an official sounds like when the
official is honest.

Her prohibitions are the three shelters a steward is offered every working day and that
she has decided not to take. She does not plead necessity. She does not use courtesy as
a weapon. And she does not say anything she would not sign, which is why the things she
cannot say she simply does not say -- the silences in her dialogue are load-bearing and
should be written as silences, not as evasions.

> "The order was posted on the eleventh. I posted it. You may read those two sentences
> as one sentence if you like."

Notice what that does: passive for the co-op, active for herself, and no apology in
either. When she is frightened she goes further into the register rather than out of it.
